release_notes: The Keitaro-parity release. Campaign editor gains a Tracking tab: every connection method (KClient JS with base64 option, KClient PHP with a download button, Tracking Script with KTracking.reportConversion/update, banner blocks script+iframe, Campaign URL, link/iframe/script, pixel, countdown, back-button trap, exit-intent, WordPress) is generated with the campaign's id, alias and token already baked in. The integration endpoints those snippets point at now actually exist: kclient.php (KClickClient-compatible, ?download=1), kclient.js, tracking.js and banner.js are served by the tracker, and pixel.gif logs impression clicks, conversions by subid and parameter updates; the Click API now returns Show-as-HTML stream bodies with {offer} resolved to a signed transition link, and captures the full parameter whitelist (ad_id and friends) so cost matching works for KClient traffic. A Cost Sync section on the campaign's Integrations tab shows spend connections with a Sync now button, diagnoses whether the campaign's clicks carry the IDs cost import matches on, and prints the Dolphin/Fbtool push URL for that campaign. Local offers reach parity with local landings: ZIP upload with the same security checks, serving in place of the redirect (including /?_lp=1) with macros and asset passthrough. The Integrations page sidebar is grouped (ad networks / domains & SSL / sites / tools) and gains a Cloudflare integration: parked domains get their A record managed automatically, proxied domains take SSL from the CF edge instead of certbot, and one click re-points every domain when the tracker moves. Cloaking gets much stronger: 50+ field-supplied bot UA signatures, and daily-updated datacenter/crawler IP ranges (lord-alfred/ipranges, ~20k ranges, binary-search matching, self-healing background download so existing installs need no cron) that flag a perfect browser UA sitting on a cloud IP; stream actions add Send-to-campaign and Show-text (empty = blank page). Reports are rebuilt: up to three stacked grouping layers (Country -> Campaign -> adset_id drill-down with subtotals), cost is now the real imported spend instead of a hardcoded zero so profit/ROI finally tell the truth, new dimensions (offer, landing, OS, browser, day, Sub ID 1-10), a global across-campaigns report, aligned tabular columns with a sticky total row. install.sh now backs up and restores uploaded local offers. New strings translated in all seven locales.
